articles.summary: Third quarter GAAP total revenues of $342 million, up 22% year-over-year as compared to non-GAAP adjusted total revenues - Third quarter DAYBUE® GAAP net sales of $140 million, up 39% year-over-year driven by strong uptake of DAYBUE STIX - Third quarter NUPLAZID® GAAP net sales of $202 million, up 12% year-over-year on a non-GAAP adjusted basis - Raises 2026 DAYBUE net sales guidance to $505–$520 million; narrows NUPLAZID range and total revenue range - Additional data from Phase 3-enabling RADIANT Phase 2 Study to be presented at the Clinical Trials on Alzheimer’s Disease conference on November 17 Acadia Pharmaceuticals Inc. articles.title: Acadia Pharmaceuticals Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
